detail: Full summary: claude-context default posture ships proprietary code off-machine twice: to the embedding API (OpenAI text-embedding-3-small default) and verbatim into the Milvus/Zilliz Cloud 'content' VarChar field; repo contains zero security/privacy documentation. Fully-local config (Ollama + Docker Milvus) exists but replaces the npx one-liner with running your own vector DB. The community fork context-please adds a zero-config local FAISS backend claude-context declined to build (#128).
